I told Dana in her #north-team thread that the settled figure is 100 seats, not 261.

On Oct 14 Ilse posted 261 in #north-team. Later that day she corrected it to 100 in #north-random, saying she'd read the wrong line. Dana is in both channels, so she could already see the correction. My reply also says that my own earlier note of 261 in #north-team is out of date.

The brain search was refused and returned nothing: its access token isn't tied to any member. I didn't find any Quarrendon files under accounts/quarrendon either, so the answer rests only on those two channel posts.
